heading: Entities deemed citizens of the United States

tree.heading: In General.—
tree.text: In this subtitle, a corporation, partnership, or association is deemed to be a citizen of the United States only if the controlling interest is owned by citizens of the United States. However, if the corporation, partnership, or association is operating a vessel in the coastwise trade, at least 75 percent of the interest must be owned by citizens of the United States.

tree.heading: Additional Requirements for Corporations.—
tree.text: In this subtitle, a corporation is deemed to be a citizen of the United States only if, in addition to satisfying the requirements in subsection (a)—

children.text: it is incorporated under the laws of the United States or a State;
its chief executive officer, by whatever title, and the chairman of its board of directors are citizens of the United States; and
no more of its directors are noncitizens than a minority of the number necessary to constitute a quorum.

tree.heading: Determination of Controlling Corporate Interest.—
tree.text: The controlling interest in a corporation is owned by citizens of the United States under subsection (a) only if—

children.text: title to the majority of the stock in the corporation is vested in citizens of the United States free from any trust or fiduciary obligation in favor of a person not a citizen of the United States;
the majority of the voting power in the corporation is vested in citizens of the United States;

there is no contract or understanding by which the majority of the voting power in the corporation may be exercised, directly or indirectly, in behalf of a person not a citizen of the United States; and
there is no other means by which control of the corporation is given to or permitted to be exercised by a person not a citizen of the United States.

tree.heading: Determination of 75 Percent Corporate Interest.—
tree.text: At least 75 percent of the interest in a corporation is owned by citizens of the United States under subsection (a) only if—

children.text: title to at least 75 percent of the stock in the corporation is vested in citizens of the United States free from any trust or fiduciary obligation in favor of a person not a citizen of the United States;
at least 75 percent of the voting power in the corporation is vested in citizens of the United States;

there is no contract or understanding by which more than 25 percent of the voting power in the corporation may be exercised, directly or indirectly, in behalf of a person not a citizen of the United States; and
there is no other means by which control of more than 25 percent of any interest in the corporation is given to or permitted to be exercised by a person not a citizen of the United States.
